ImageDescription.value:
Gallery partitioned by curtains with motif inspired by Rongo Rongo script.

The handful of objects that survived with inscriptions written in the island’s famous Rongo Rongo script could not be deciphered.

Rapa Nui is the only island, apart from New Zealand, where Polynesians developed a system of writing. Researchers draw upon a wide range of disciplines including archaeology, to shed light on what happened on Rapa Nui in the past.

’If truth is to be found in the island’s early history then it lies instead in the stones and bones of the archaeology, tongues of linguistics, grains of palynology, DNA of genetics and other material evidence serving an array of modern disciplines…’

Steven Roger Fischer (2005) Island at the End of the World (Reaktion Books)
